rows.en:
(I promised to go out with Claire-senpai
again today...)
So, where should we go today?
I want to buy some new clothes.
What kind of clothes are you planning to buy?

I've been invited to my cousin's wedding~
so I need to go buy a dress...
rows.notes: Itoko written with the 'elder female cousin' kanji; 'cousin' is enough.

rows.en: That's wonderful news!
Hehe, thank you.
What about you, Claire-senpai?
What about me?
Getting married.

Hey, just how old do you think I am!?
I'm 19! A teenager in full bloom!!

Eeeek...
I-I'm sooo sorry~!!
Of course I'm not getting married yet.
O-oh, okay.
Are you relieved?
Huh? Well, yeah, kinda... I mean, yes!

Look at that happy face!
How cute!!
Please stop poking my cheek~!
Then I'll do this!

Nggghh...
Pwease don't pull my cheeksh~

Ahaha!
It stretches just like mochi~!

Thanks for today.
I found a nice dress thanks to you.

You're welcome.
I'm glad I got to see you in a beautiful
dress, Senpai.

Honestly, the only thing you've gotten
better at is flattery...
I'm telling the truth! I don't flatter people!
Thank you, that makes me happy.
Well then, shall we head home?
Why don't we hold hands on the way?
Y-yesss!!
(Senpai's hand is so smooth~!)

(I promised to go out with Claire-senpai
again today...)
So, where are we going today?
Congratulations to them!!
rows.notes: Female only; the congratulations are for the cousin's wedding.

rows.en: Getting married, of course.

Please stop poking my cheek~
Senpai!

What cute cheeks!
I could just eat them up!!
I'm telling the truth! I don't flatter people!
(Senpai's hand is so smooth~!)
(Shopping with Claire-senpai again today.)
(Whoa! Senpai's already here!!)

You're late, \p-kun.
You've got some nerve, keeping me waiting.
I-I'm sorry.
rows.notes: x6: player here and in frd_itk_103, Luca in frd_luk_004.

rows.en:
As punishment, maybe I'll have you
treat me to a crepe.

...Well, if you want one, Senpai,
it's my treat anyway!
rows.notes: Player: not as a punishment, but gladly.

rows.en: Then let's eat it together.
rows.notes: One crepe shared, hence the player's reaction.

rows.en: (Wait, does that mean...!!)
Ah, you're thinking something weird.
I-I am not!
Are you really sure about that?
That crepe was delicious~

The sweet smell of the batter cooking is
the best. And the cream wasn't too sweet
or too heavy, either.

Yeah, yeah. It was worth waiting in line
for an hour~

Well then, shall we walk to the station
together?
(That crepe was delicious~)

You're late, \p-chan.
You've got some nerve, keeping me waiting.

(I got to spend another fun day
with Claire-senpai.)
Hehe, today was fun too.
I'm glad to hear you say that.
Say, do you have... some time after this?
Time? Sure, I do.
Then how about we go to my special spot?
Your special spot?

Did you forget?
The special spot with the beautiful sunset.
Oh, Griffith Park!!

Correct!
I was worried you might have forgotten.
(That was a close one...)
Th-there's no way I'd forget.

That's where you took me when you
showed me around town, Senpai.

Hehe, just kidding.
Well then, shall we go?

What a nice view.
And the breeze feels so good...
...Did something happen?
No, not really. Nothing happened.
Maybe it's because nothing has... I guess.
rows.notes: Nani mo nai kara... kana: she is restless precisely because nothing has happened between them (the next lines). Kept close to the Japanese.

rows.en:
There are all kinds of people around you,
and you're busy every single day.

And still, you spend your time
with me like this.
That makes me really happy, but...
Senpai?

I wonder what I am to you?
Just your senpai?
Or...
I like you.

Not as my underclassman,
but as a man.

uncertain: c04668: 'Maybe it's because nothing has... I guess.' read as nothing having happened between them (the lines after it)
